name: Downshift · Combobox

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Downshift (https://www.downshift-js.com/).
Technology stack: react, javascript, typescript.
Component specification: 最后开 useCombobox：输入框加列表的无障碍组合框。
Key visual & interaction patterns: Combobox.
Visual details from source observation: 打开 downshift-js.com，标题写 WAI-ARIA 的 autocomplete/combobox 或 select。左侧 Hooks 列出 useSelect、useCombobox。useSelect 页讲 getter props 对标原生 select。useCombobox 页讲输入框加列表的无障碍组合框。适合要自己画皮下拉、还要把键盘和读屏做对的人。MIT；版权行仍署 PayPal。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
